content: It includes studies, reports, and evaluations from different countries, focusing on topics such as the safety, acceptability, barriers, motivators, and outcomes of VMMC programs. The references also explore the role of community beliefs, healthcare providers, and policy environments in influencing the uptake of VMMC, as well as the integration of VMMC with other health services like tetanus vaccination and HIV prevention strategies. Additionally, the studies examine the perceptions of men, women, and healthcare providers regarding VMMC, as well as the psychological, sexual, and cultural factors associated with the procedure.
